summary: A weekly Tuesday night music night at The One Stop (Asheville Music Hall) anchored by a fixed house band ("Trilateral Omission", featuring members of Empire Strikes Brass) that plays 8-10pm, followed by an open sit-in hour from 10-11pm explicitly open to "musicians from inside the AVL community and anywhere beyond." It reads as a band residency plus open-door jam, not a persistent membership community: no dues, sign-up roster, or club identity, and the sit-in segment is framed as welcoming any visiting musician rather than a returning known cohort.

evidence.note: Listing text is minimal and generic each week: "Weekly Jam hosted by members of AVL's Empire Strikes Brass! Always live & always different!" with tags like Open Jam, Pickup Musicians, Casual Drop In, Sit In Friendly.

Names a fixed four-piece house band, The Trilateral Omission (JP Furnas, Lenny Pettinelli, Sean Mason), that plays first, followed by an open sit-in hour for "musicians from inside the AVL community and anywhere beyond" - explicitly rotating, not a closed cohort.
Search snippet describes it as "one of the longest standing & best open jams in town," emphasizing openness rather than a defined membership.
Has a dedicated Facebook page (not a members-only group), consistent with a recurring venue night rather than a club; page content itself was not fetchable to confirm further.
